summary: The note is a short biographical entry on Leonard Irwin Thompson, born July 28, 1952, in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. It identifies him as a former American football wide receiver in the National Football League. He spent his entire NFL career with the Detroit Lions from 1975 to 1986.
one_line: Leonard Irwin Thompson is a former NFL wide receiver who played his whole career with the Detroit Lions from 1975 to 1986.
key_facts: Leonard Irwin Thompson was born on July 28, 1952, in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.
Leonard Irwin Thompson is a former American football wide receiver.
Leonard Irwin Thompson played in the National Football League.
Leonard Irwin Thompson spent his entire NFL career with the Detroit Lions.
Leonard Thompson's Detroit Lions career spanned the years 1975 to 1986.
